scoring.release: 20 if latest stable release/tag dated in the current year, 10 previous year, 4 two years ago, else 0
scoring.license: 5 if GitHub reports an SPDX id other than NOASSERTION/none
scoring.arch: 15 official Arch repo (core/extra), 10 CachyOS-PKGBUILDS recipe, 5 AUR, 0 none
scoring.omarchy: 3 if the package is in an Omarchy default package list
scoring.tests: 5 if the repo root has a tests/test dir or CI workflows exist
scoring.credible: not archived, primary language Rust (unless allowNonRust), stars >= 300, pushed within 400 days, score >= 45; otherwise the domain is a gap
